four_hour_drift.definition: Latest completed hourly close / close four hours earlier - 1 (fractional return).

hourly_return.definition: Latest completed hourly close / previous hourly close - 1 (fractional return).

midpoint_distance.definition: (Latest hourly close - 24-hour range midpoint) / range midpoint.

pullback_depth.definition: Alias of pullback_from_high: 20-hour high-to-latest-close fractional pullback.

pullback_from_high.definition: (Maximum high of the last 20 completed hours - latest close) / maximum high.

range_high.definition: Maximum high of the last 24 completed hourly candles, in USD.

range_low.definition: Minimum low of the last 24 completed hourly candles, in USD.

sma_20.definition: Arithmetic mean of the last 20 completed hourly closes, in USD.

sma_50.definition: Arithmetic mean of the last 50 completed hourly closes, in USD.
